cases.name: complete
cases.why: The control. A corpus of only failures cannot tell a correct implementation from one that refuses everything.

cases.name: missing
cases.why: The Recorder omits empty periods rather than emitting them, so an empty list is the only signal. Today this sets a full range over an empty map and draws a plot inside an axis that claims data.

cases.name: partial
cases.why: Three consecutive days absent. The line must break; the sum must not silently omit them and present a smaller confident number.

cases.name: stale
cases.why: One sample, a month before the window. A nearest-neighbour join would report it as this week's value; it is evidence about May.

cases.name: incompatible
cases.why: A meter in Wh against a price denominated in EUR/kWh. Converting on a guess is wrong by three orders of magnitude; the answer is a refusal with a reason.

cases.name: recorder-failure
cases.why: The failure must reach the surface as `source: unavailable`. A test that feeds this and asserts the series is empty has confirmed the defect rather than caught it.

cases.name: trap-window-precedes-statistic
cases.why: statistics.py:1947 defaults the previous sum to zero, so the first bucket's change is the entire accumulated total. It is a plausible large number, not an error, and it is the whole shape of this phase.

cases.name: trap-null-sum
cases.why: A null sum yields a null change, which is a legitimate answer from the API. It must survive to the surface as no data, not be coerced to zero on the way.

cases.name: trap-circular-mean
cases.why: StatisticMeanType.CIRCULAR. The arithmetic mean of 350 and 10 degrees is exactly the opposite of the truth, and nothing downstream would flag 180.

note: Authored, not generated. Each case names the defect it exists to catch; see 07-VALIDATION.md criterion 4.
